SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. .........
S.1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date March 14, 1939.

Subject Communication dated 24-2-39 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Mrs. E.A. Leskoff.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev, Forwarded by C. Clauson

Enquiries show that Mrs. Evstolia Alexandrovna
LESKOFF nee Gildenbraun first arrived in Shanghai
from Tientsin in January, 1931. When registering
with the Russian Migrants' Committee, Moulmein Road,
she stated that she was born on November 22, 1905
at Petrograd and that in 1926 she escaped from
Vladivostok to Manchuria. Until 1930 she resided in
Harbin where she was employed as a shop-assistant in
the "Prigoda" Confectionery for several years. While
in Harbin she married one N.A. Leskoff, who was
employed as a clerk with the Chinese Eastern Railway
from 1926 to 1930. Towards the end of 1930 she left
for Tientsin and after a short stay in that city
proceeded to Shanghai to join her husband who arrived
here from Tientsin on October, 1930.

The couple are reported to have been divorced
in August, 1931. N.A. Leskoff served in the Russian
Volunteers Detachment of the French Police from
September, 1932 to May 1933 when he was dismissed,
and at present is employed with China General Omnibus
Company as a Ticket Inspector.

Mrs. Leskoff is not known to have any regular
employment while in Shanghai. In 1933, 1934 and
possibly in 1935 she spent her summer holidays in
Japan and during 1936-1937 made a trip to Europe.
Enquiries at the Japanese Consulate-General show that
in 1933, When she applied for a visa to Japan, she

日期：1939年3月14日。

事由：荷兰总领事馆1939年2月24日来函，涉及E.A. Leskoff夫人。

由侦探副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写，由C. Clauson转呈

经查，Evstolia Alexandrovna LESKOFF夫人（婚前姓Gildenbraun）于1931年1月首次从天津抵达上海。在慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）俄国移民委员会登记时，她声称自己于1905年11月22日出生于彼得格勒，并于1926年从符拉迪沃斯托克逃往满洲。直至1930年，她一直居住在哈尔滨，并在“Prigoda”糖果店担任店员数年。在哈尔滨期间，她与N.A. Leskoff结婚，后者于1926年至1930年间受雇于中东铁路局任职员。1930年底，她前往天津，在该市短暂停留后，前往上海与丈夫团聚，其丈夫于1930年10月从天津抵达此处。

据报，夫妇二人于1931年8月离婚。N.A. Leskoff于1932年9月至1933年5月在法租界巡捕房俄国志愿队服役，后被解职，目前受雇于中国公共汽车公司担任查票员。

Leskoff夫人在上海期间据知无固定职业。1933年、1934年及可能包括1935年，她在日本度过暑假，并于1936-1937年间赴欧洲旅行。向日本总领事馆查询显示，1933年她申请赴日签证时，

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 584.                                          SHANGHAI,       24th February 1939.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Madame Evstolia Ale-
xandroma LISKOVA has applied to this Consulate-General for a
visé for admission into the Netherlands Indies.

Madame Leskova, who stated to have been born at Petrograd,
on November 22, 1905, is in possession of a Identification Cer-
tificate No. 7517, issued by the Police of the French Concession
at Shanghai on April 19, 1938.

Besides she is still in possession of an expired Chinese
passport No. 7253 issued by the former Bureau of Public Safety at
Shanghai on June 10, 1936, from which it appears that during the
years 1936-1937 she travelled to Europe and visited various
countries, viz. Italy, Germany, and Czechoslovakia.

Furthermore she stated that she resided in Shanghai during
the last eight years and that she intends to visit the Nether-
lands Indies in May or June next.

The applicant, a divorcee, who is a cosmetic and beauty ope-
rator, resides at 1377 Avenue Road, apartment 315.

From her appearance and conversation it seems that she is very
nervous and feebleminded.

According to her statement she registered with the Russian
Emigrants Committee, Moulmein Road in June 1938.

I should be obliged to you if you would let me know, if
possible, whether anything is known against this person from a
political or moral point of view.

                                                    I have the honour to be,
                                                               Sir,
                                                    Your obedient servant,

The Deputy Commissioner                                     (Signature)
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,                  Consul.

SHANGHAI.
(Handwritten annotations: D.S.S. Robertson, C 3/2, 21/3, and other illegible marks)

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第 584 号。                                          上海，       1939年2月24日。

先生：

谨此告知，Evstolia Alexandroma LISKOVA 女士已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

Leskova 女士声称于1905年11月22日出生于彼得格勒，持有1938年4月19日由上海法租界巡捕房签发的第7517号身份证明书。

此外，她仍持有一本已过期的中国护照，号码为7253，由前上海公安局于1936年6月10日签发，从中可见她在1936-1937年间曾前往欧洲，访问了意大利、德国和捷克斯洛伐克等国。

此外，她声称过去八年居住在上海，并打算于明年五月或六月访问荷属东印度。

申请人系离异人士，职业为化妆品及美容师，居住于爱文义路（Avenue Road）1377号315室。

从其外表和谈吐来看，她似乎非常神经质且智力低下。

据其陈述，她于1938年6月在慕尔鸣路俄国移民委员会进行了登记。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否掌握对此人不利的情况，我将不胜感激。

                                                    谨致
                                                               敬礼，

                                                    上海公共租界工部局警务处                  （签名）
特别课副督察长                                  领事。

上海。
（手写批注：D.S.S. Robertson, C 3/2, 21/3，及其他难以辨认的标记）
